allocation_scope: Rust GlobalAlloc only; C++ and native GMP/MPFR allocations are unobserved. Separate build, absent from primary timings.
input_boundary: Five raw positive-energy momenta, five helicities, seven free model inputs and scale squared. Both complete paths include the same FeynKit numerical preparation and coefficient evaluation.

warmup_validation_scope: Integrated Laurent values and internal finite-split identities; preparation baseline checks equality. Raw and Float256 oracle controls are separate.
